info.name: MW Realty API
info.description: REST API for the MW Realty mobile app: property search, listings, agents, content, customer accounts, enquiries and the AI assistant.

request.description: The languages content is available in. Send the chosen `code` as `?lang=` on every request.

Prices from every endpoint are in AED; to display another currency, multiply by its `rate`
(units per 1 AED).

Static UI copy (labels, buttons…) as a key → text map for one language. Cache it on the
device per language.

item.name: Search & Filters
item.description:
Public read-only endpoint the frontend (home banner + /properties listing)
uses to render the search filter bar. Options come straight from the
admin-managed filters/filter_values tables, so a new filter or option
shows up here without a code change. Option counts and slider bounds use
the listings of the page asking: residential by default, or `?scope=commercial` for /commercial.

query.description: Whose listings the counts/bounds come from: residential, commercial, premium, marketing.

request.description:
The filters to render (selects with their options and live listing counts, number sliders
with min/max/step), in admin order. Pass the chosen `value`s back to the listing endpoints
under each filter's `key`.

Cities, communities and addresses matching what the user typed (2+ characters; fewer
returns an empty list). Pass a picked suggestion back as `city=` / `community=` /
`location=` on the listing endpoints. Debounce on the client — limited to 120 calls/minute.

query.description: Purpose: sale, rent or off_plan. e.g. `rent`.

request.description: Commercial listings (16 per page) — same response shape as `GET /api/properties`.

{"id":111,"slug":"virella-2","name":"Virella 2","description":"

Nestled in the heart of Dubai's most coveted family-oriented destination, Virella 2 by Emaar Properties represents the pinnacle of contemporary residential living. This exceptional development embodies Emaar's renowned commitment to creating communities that seamlessly blend luxury, comfort, and lifestyle excellence. As the latest addition to The Valley's expanding portfolio of premium residential offerings, Virella 2 promises to redefine modern family living through its thoughtful design, world-class amenities, and strategic positioning within one of Dubai's most promising master-planned communities.

The development showcases Emaar's signature approach to community planning, where every element is meticulously crafted to enhance residents' quality of life. From the moment you enter Virella 2, you'll discover a harmonious environment where architectural brilliance meets natural beauty, creating an oasis of tranquility that remains perfectly connected to Dubai's vibrant urban landscape.

Prime Location Analysis: The Valley's Strategic Advantages

The Valley stands as one of Dubai's most strategically positioned residential destinations, offering residents the perfect balance between serene suburban living and urban accessibility. This master-planned community spans across vast green landscapes, providing a refreshing contrast to the city's bustling metropolitan areas while maintaining excellent connectivity to key business and leisure districts.

Key Location Benefits:

  • Family-Centric Environment: The Valley is specifically designed as a family-friendly destination with safe, pedestrian-friendly pathways and abundant green spaces
  • Natural Landscapes: Surrounded by rolling hills and pristine desert vistas, offering residents a unique connection to Dubai's natural beauty
  • Growing Infrastructure: Continuous development of retail, dining, and entertainment facilities within the community
  • Educational Proximity: Close access to renowned international schools and educational institutions
  • Healthcare Facilities: Well-planned healthcare infrastructure ensuring comprehensive medical services nearby

The location offers residents the rare opportunity to enjoy a peaceful, community-oriented lifestyle while remaining within easy reach of Dubai's major employment centers, shopping destinations, and entertainment hubs.

Unique Architectural Features and Design Elements

Virella 2 showcases contemporary architectural excellence that reflects Emaar's commitment to innovative design and sustainable living. The development features clean lines, modern facades, and thoughtfully planned layouts that maximize natural light and ventilation throughout each residence.

Design Highlights:

  • Contemporary Architecture: Sleek, modern design language that complements The Valley's natural landscape
  • Sustainable Features: Energy-efficient systems and environmentally conscious building materials
  • Open-Plan Living: Spacious interiors designed to promote family interaction and comfortable living
  • Premium Finishes: High-quality materials and fixtures throughout all residential units
  • Landscape Integration: Seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living spaces
  • Smart Home Ready: Infrastructure prepared for modern technology integration

The architectural vision prioritizes both aesthetic appeal and functional living, ensuring that each home serves as a perfect sanctuary for modern families seeking luxury and comfort.

Detailed Amenities and Facilities Overview

Virella 2 is designed to provide residents with a comprehensive lifestyle experience through its extensive range of world-class amenities and facilities. Every aspect of the development is planned to enhance daily living and create opportunities for recreation, wellness, and community engagement.

Recreation and Wellness:

  • State-of-the-art fitness center with modern equipment
  • Swimming pools designed for both adults and children
  • Dedicated children's play areas with safe, engaging equipment
  • Landscaped parks and gardens for relaxation and outdoor activities
  • Walking and jogging trails throughout the community
  • Multi-purpose sports facilities for various activities

Community Facilities:

  • Community center for social gatherings and events
  • Retail outlets for daily convenience shopping
  • Dedicated parking spaces for residents and guests
  • 24/7 security systems ensuring safety and peace of mind
  • Professional property management services
  • Maintenance and landscaping services

Lifestyle and Community Aspects

Living in Virella 2 means becoming part of a vibrant, close-knit community where neighbors become friends and every day offers new opportunities for connection and enjoyment. The development fosters a lifestyle that celebrates both privacy and community engagement, allowing residents to choose their level of social interaction while always feeling part of something larger.

Community Living Benefits:

  • Family-Oriented Environment: Safe spaces for children to play and families to gather
  • Social Opportunities: Regular community events and activities that bring neighbors together
  • Peaceful Atmosphere: Quiet, residential setting away from urban noise and congestion
  • Active Lifestyle: Numerous opportunities for outdoor recreation and fitness activities
  • Cultural Diversity: Welcoming community that celebrates Dubai's multicultural character

The lifestyle at Virella 2 emphasizes work-life balance, providing residents with a peaceful retreat where they can recharge while maintaining easy access to Dubai's dynamic business and entertainment districts.

Investment Potential and Market Value

Virella 2 represents an exceptional investment opportunity in Dubai's thriving real estate market. The combination of Emaar's proven track record, The Valley's strategic location, and the development's premium features positions this project for strong capital appreciation and rental yields.

Investment Advantages:

  • Developer Reputation: Emaar Properties' established history of delivering high-quality developments
  • Location Growth: The Valley's continued development and infrastructure improvements
  • Rental Demand: Strong demand for family-friendly rental properties in Dubai
  • Capital Appreciation: Potential for long-term property value growth
  • Dubai's Economic Growth: Benefit from the emirate's continued economic expansion and population growth

Connectivity and Accessibility

Despite its tranquil setting, Virella 2 offers excellent connectivity to Dubai's major destinations through well-planned transportation infrastructure. Residents enjoy easy access to key areas while living in a peaceful, family-friendly environment.

Transportation Links:

  • Convenient access to major highways connecting to Dubai's business districts
  • Public transportation options for daily commuting
  • Proximity to Dubai International Airport for frequent travelers
  • Easy access to major shopping destinations like Dubai Mall and Mall of the Emirates
  • Quick connectivity to Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, and other key areas

Developer Profile: Emaar Properties

Emaar Properties stands as one of the world's most respected real estate developers, with an impressive portfolio that includes iconic developments such as the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and numerous master-planned communities across Dubai and internationally. With decades of experience in creating exceptional residential and commercial developments, Emaar brings unmatched expertise to every project.

Emaar's Commitment:

  • Proven track record of on-time project delivery
  • Commitment to quality construction and premium finishes
  • Comprehensive after-sales service and community management
  • Innovation in design and sustainable development practices
  • Strong financial stability and market reputation

Your Gateway to Exceptional Living

Virella 2 by Emaar Properties represents more than just a residential development – it's an invitation to experience the finest aspects of Dubai living. This exceptional community offers families the opportunity to enjoy luxury, comfort, and connectivity in one of the city's most promising locations.

Whether you're seeking a permanent family home or a strategic investment opportunity, Virella 2 delivers on every front. With Emaar's reputation for excellence, The Valley's family-friendly environment, and the development's premium amenities, this project stands ready to exceed your expectations.

{"post":{"slug":"5-reasons-to-invest-in-dubai-off-plan-properties","category":"investment","category_label":"Investment","title":"5 Reasons to Invest in Dubai Off-Plan Properties in 2026","content":"

Off-plan investment continues to be one of the most attractive routes into the Dubai property market. With flexible payment plans, strong capital appreciation, and a steady pipeline of new communities, 2026 is shaping up to be another strong year for buyers who purchase before a project is completed.

If you're weighing up an off-plan purchase against a ready property, here are five reasons it's worth a closer look.

1. Lower Entry Prices and Flexible Payment Plans

Off-plan units are typically priced below comparable ready properties in the same community, and developers routinely offer post-handover payment plans that spread the cost over several years. That makes it possible to secure a unit in a sought-after location with a fraction of the capital required for a ready home.

2. Strong Capital Appreciation Potential

Properties purchased at launch price have historically appreciated as a project nears completion and the surrounding community matures. Early buyers in established master developments have seen some of the strongest gains in the market.

"Buyers who get in early on a well-located off-plan project are, in effect, buying tomorrow's finished community at today's launch price."

3. Modern Specifications and Warranties

New developments are built to the latest building codes and typically come with developer warranties on structure and finishing — an advantage over older ready stock that may need renovation soon after purchase.

What to check before you commit

  • The developer's track record and history of on-time handovers
  • Escrow account protections for your payment plan
  • Realistic expectations for the handover timeline
  • Total cost including DLD fees, service charges, and any registration costs

4. Access to Prime Locations Before They're Built Out

Emerging communities often sell their best-positioned units — waterfront, park-facing, or corner plots — in the earliest launch phases. Buying off-plan is frequently the only way to secure these premium positions before they're gone.

5. Golden Visa Eligibility

Off-plan purchases that meet the UAE's investment threshold can qualify buyers for long-term residency, adding a lifestyle dimension to what might otherwise be a purely financial decision.

As with any investment, due diligence matters. Work with a licensed agent, verify the developer's RERA registration, and make sure the payment plan and expected handover date fit your own financial timeline before signing.

Permanently deletes the account (required by the App Store / Play Store for apps with

item.name: User Auth
item.description:
Token (Bearer) auth for the mobile app's **User** account (buyers/visitors). Agents and
agencies don't sign in through these endpoints.

Same accounts, OTP and Google rules as the website's session login
(Customer\CustomerAuthController) — the only difference is that a successful sign-in returns
a Sanctum token instead of a cookie.

Send the token on every authenticated request: `Authorization: Bearer {token}`.

request.description:
Step 1 of sign-up. Creates the account and emails a 4-digit code — no token yet; call
`POST /api/auth/verify-otp` with the returned `user_id` and the code.
`email_sent: false` means the email failed — offer "Resend code".

response.body: {"message": "The email has already been taken.", "errors": {"email": ["The email has already been taken."]}}
response.name: Validation error

request.description:
Step 2 of sign-up: the 4-digit code emailed by `POST /api/auth/register`. Marks the
email verified and returns a Bearer token.

response.body: {"message": "Could not send the code right now — please try again in a moment."}

request.description: Email + password sign-in. Returns a Bearer token for the `Authorization` header.

Exchange the access token from the native Google Sign-In SDK for an app token. Links to an
existing account with the same email, or creates one. For the **User** account only —
agents and agencies don't have Google sign-in (show the button only on the User tab).

Emails a reset link (opens the website's reset page). Always the same reply, whether or not
the email is registered.

response.body: {"message": "If an account exists for that email, a reset link has been sent."}

request.description:
Only needed if the app handles the reset link itself (deep link
`/reset-password?token=...&email=...`); otherwise the website page does this.

response.body: {"message": "Your password has been reset — you can now sign in."}

request.description: Revokes the token used for this request (other devices stay signed in).
